classification_vocabulary.preserve: Retain substantially as-is because the asset and its architectural role remain suitable.
classification_vocabulary.port: Transfer valuable implementation or behavior into the target architecture with bounded adaptation.
classification_vocabulary.rewrite: Retain the capability or obligation while replacing an implementation that conflicts with the target architecture.
classification_vocabulary.retire: Deliberately remove behavior or tooling superseded by the target architecture after replacement evidence exists.
classification_vocabulary.evidence: Retain for historical, regression, conformance, or differential comparison, not as future implementation.
classification_vocabulary.discard: Exclude accidental, obsolete, generated, packaged, or otherwise irrelevant material from preservation obligations.

capabilities.capability: Structured shared conformance fixture contract
capabilities.architectural_role: Versioned interchange shape for shared semantic, diagnostic, IR, and code-generation cases.
capabilities.rationale: The schema is governed by an enforced public snapshot and is a useful contract boundary, although implementation-derived expected values remain lower-authority evidence.
capabilities.future_destination: Versioned conformance data contracts
reuse_prerequisites: Remove TypeScript-oracle wording when independently authored cases replace implementation-derived expectations.
Version any incompatible field change through the public contract process.

capabilities.future_destination: Authoritative versioned standard-library specification

Resolve incomplete RFC coverage and target-portability expectations.
